decisions.decision_value: Selling price of 25 Euro, profit aim of 50 million Euro, and maximum production cost of 12.50 Euro per remote
decisions.rationale: Company financial targets for an international product marketed in the States, Europe, and Asia
decisions.semantic_target_quote: the selling price for our remote is going to be twenty-five Euro, and our profit aim is fifty million Euro.

decisions.decision_value: Make a multifunctional universal remote control for TV, DVD, sound system, and TiVo
decisions.rationale: Initial desire for one remote that operates all entertainment devices
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Well, we wanna make a multifunctional remote, right? One remote for everything.

decisions.decision_value: Discussed AA batteries (commonly available at home), AAA batteries (preferred by Marketing Expert D if making the remote thinner), and a small lithium battery (suggested by Industrial Designer B)
decisions.rationale: C noted most people have AAs around, D preferred AAAs for a thinner remote, and B suggested a small lithium battery
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Yeah, if we want it to be more thin, then we'd probably wanna go with a triple A_.

decisions.decision_value: TV-only remote control (no DVD, no TiVo, no stereo, no teletext)
decisions.rationale: New project requirements restrict the product to a TV remote only and drop outdated teletext
decisions.semantic_target_quote: First it's only going to be a T_V_ remote. We're trying not to over-complicate things. So no D_V_D_, no TiVo, no stereo.

decisions.decision_value: Include the company colour (yellow) and company logo (RR / Real Reaction) on the remote
decisions.rationale: New corporate requirement to promote the company brand
decisions.semantic_target_quote: And we th need to promote our company more, so we need to somehow include our colour and our company slogan on the remote.

decisions.decision_value: Keep button count low with only essential buttons: power on/off, volume up/down, mute, channel up/down, numbers 0-9, and a menu button
decisions.rationale: Users only use 10% of buttons on standard remotes and want a simple, user-friendly layout
decisions.semantic_target_quote: So we've pretty much pared it down to on-off, volume, mute, channel up and down, um the numbers Yeah.

decisions.decision_value: Hard gun-metal grey plastic base with replaceable soft latex covers and a cutout showing the yellow RR logo
decisions.rationale: Allows keeping a durable plastic base while offering trendy, squishy changeable latex covers (such as fruit-themed cherry covers)
decisions.semantic_target_quote: They could come back. And buy the extra case. So we could do like a b a hard base plastic, and then we could give two latex covers to start.

decisions.decision_value: Use the sample sensor/speaker chip only as a key-phrase locator ('remote missing') for finding the lost remote, not for full voice channel changing
decisions.rationale: Avoids accidental triggers during normal conversation and avoids the clunkiness of a charging base while utilizing the new sample sensor/speaker chip
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Well, we could give it a specific code, you know, remote missing.

decisions.decision_value: Rejected charging base, solar cells, hand dynamo, and kinetic power; narrowed battery choice to AAA batteries (preferred by Marketing Expert Courtney because they are lighter, thinner, and more come in a package) vs. one small lithium battery (suggested by Industrial Designer Amber because lithium batteries are widely available in electronics and have a longer 5-year battery life)
decisions.rationale: Amber (B) advocated for one small lithium battery due to wide availability and longer 5-year battery life, while Courtney (D) preferred AAA batteries because they make the remote lighter and thinner and more come in a package
decisions.semantic_target_quote: I think, well, we could d r do two or we could do one small lithium, 'cause you know the lithium batteries are doing quite well

decisions.decision_value: Pale blue indented buttons that illuminate in yellow when pressed
decisions.rationale: Incorporates the yellow company colour and allows operation in the dark
decisions.semantic_target_quote: where the button is actually blue, but the number itself is clear or white or whatever so if you pressed it would illuminate yellow.

decisions.decision_value: Single-curved hand-sized casing with push-buttons on top (numbers in circular dial, menu, mute) and channel/volume push-buttons on the sides
decisions.rationale: Hand-sized prototype fits a single curve comfortably and uses push-buttons on top and both sides rather than scroll wheels
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Integrated scroll-wheel or push-button. We're really having just push-button interface.

decisions.rationale: Requires only a single battery component instead of multiple AAA batteries, suits technologically advanced buyers, and keeps total production cost at 11.20 Euro (under the 12.50 Euro budget)
decisions.semantic_target_quote: this is where we need to make a final call on if it's a lithium or do we wanna go triple A_s, 'cause triple A_s we're gonna have t do more than one battery. Oh, let's just go for a lithium.

decisions.decision_value: Final production cost is 11.20 Euro per unit, within the 12.50 Euro budget
decisions.rationale: Includes 1 lithium battery, 1 voice sensor chip, single-curved plastic case in special colour, 3 push-button interfaces, and special colour/form/material buttons
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Well, we're under cost then. Alright. No, we're under. Twelve point five is our limit. We've got eleven point two.

action_items.task_description: Revisit and finalize the battery choice between AAA batteries and a single lithium battery in the fourth meeting
action_items.resolution_summary: The team selected a single lithium battery during the budget calculation in ES2010d, bringing the final cost to 11.20 Euro.
action_items.semantic_target_quote: We could think about it and come back to it next meeting. We still have one more meeting.
